_about: Synthetic extraction cases modelled on real mail layouts observed 2026-10-10 (docs/_research/2026-10-10_package-tracking.md, Validation). Every name, address, order id and tracking number is fake; tracking numbers are generated to pass (or deliberately fail) the jkeen/tracking_number_data check digits.

cases.name: walmart_fulfilled_by_walmart_shipped
cases.subject: Shipped: Example Vitamin Chews...
cases.plain:
Order date: Mon, Sep 14, 2026
Order number: 2000111-11111111
# Your package shipped, Alex!
Track package
Arrives Wed, Sep 16
Sold by Example Pro Seller | Fulfilled by Walmart
Track your package: 55511014564076268801
cases.note: Walmart last-mile number: 20 digits, '555' prefix, no public carrier. All links are encrypted w-mt.co redirects.

cases.name: walmart_555_number_that_collides_with_usps20_checksum
cases.subject: Shipped: Example Washer Mat...
cases.plain:
Order number: 2000222-22222222
Sold by Example Seller | Fulfilled by Walmart
Track your package: 55511014564076268800
cases.note: Passes the USPS 20 mod10 check by chance (1 in 10 do). Sender rule must win over the checksum classifier, or this is polled against USPS and never resolves.

cases.name: walmart_last_mile_out_for_delivery
cases.subject: Your package should arrive by 3:01pm📦
cases.plain:
Order date: Mon, Sep 14, 2026 Order number: 2000111-11111111
# Your delivery is on the way, Alex!
The delivery driver, Sam, is making other stops nearby and should arrive by 3:01pm.
### Delivery from store
cases.note: No tracking number: correlate to the shipped package by order number. Same-subject OFD mails from different orders get merged into one Gmail thread, so threadId is not a key.

cases.name: fedex_delivery_manager_on_the_way

cases.note: Carrier notification: number in subject and trknbr param, merchant order id in Reference.

cases.name: merchant_labeled_fedex_number_and_order_id_lookalike
cases.subject: Your order has shipped!
cases.plain:
Order Number: 1009999999
In transit
Carrier: FedEx®
Tracking number: 753045655424
cases.note: The 10-digit order number matches the DHL Express regex but fails its mod7 check and has no DHL context: must not become a package.
